components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Mint sticker CTA with ink outline and hard offset shadow.

components.css: .ds-craft-card { border: 1.5px solid #163e4c; border-radius: 12px; padding: 25px 25px 21px; background: #ffe0e9; color: #164d5b; box-shadow: 4px 5px 0 #173e4c; transition: transform .2s; } .ds-craft-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-card-top span:first-child { font-weight: 800; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; width: 31px; height: 31px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-craft-card h3 { font-size: 26px; margin: 25px 0 12px; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-craft-card p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.9; margin: 0 0 26px; } .ds-card-bottom { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-top: 1px solid #164d5b30; padding-top: 15px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-card-bottom button { background: #ffffffa0; border: 1px solid #163e4c; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 23px; color: #164d5b; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Stacked brand mark: cyan domi, pink heart, tracked HOMESTUDIO.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1; align-items: center; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand strong { font-size: 43px; letter-spacing: -3px; color: #147c99; font-weight: 950; } .ds-brand strong span { font-size: 17px; color: #ec85a4; vertical-align: top; margin-left: 4px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-brand small { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 3px; margin-top: 9px; font-weight: 800; color: #164d5b; }

components.name: Week Day
components.description: Equal-height day selector. Times never expand inside this card.
components.css: .ds-week-day { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-height: 118px; min-width: 128px; text-align: left; padding: 14px 12px 12px; background: #fffafb; color: #164d5b; border: 1.5px solid #163e4c; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-week-day:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-week-day.is-selected { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #163e4c; transform: translate(-1px, -2px); } .ds-week-day:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0585aa; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-week-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-week-day time { font-size: 12px; color: #377988; } .ds-week-count { margin-top: auto; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Slot Status
components.description: Hour chip for the fixed-height slot panel: open, remaining, full, or past. Capacity is 3 people.
components.html: 19:00可约20:00已满18:00已过
components.css: .ds-slots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-slot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #163e4c; border-radius: 5px; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: #fff; color: #164d5b; } .ds-slot.open span:last-child { color: #076e8a; } .ds-slot.booked { background: #ffe6ee; color: #a64669; border-color: #edb3c5; } .ds-slot.booked span:first-child { text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-slot.past { background: #d5f7fc; color: #164d5b; border-color: #a7d5df; }

narrative.overview:
domi homestudio 是一间拼豆、美甲与热缩片手绘小店的预览站。视觉世界不是豪华电商，也不是扁平 SaaS：它像一间像素爱心工坊——藏青墨色写字，糖果粉画心，薄荷绿当按钮，卡通插画（47 抱着小恐龙 domi）承担品牌记忆。界面密度适中：大标题很重（900），正文很松（行高 1.8），卡片像贴在纸上的色块贴纸。

气质是可爱、像素、工坊、可触摸。中英混排是品牌声音的一部分：中文承担情感标题，英文大写 eyebrow / 项目编号承担工坊标签。♥、✦、↗ 是固定符号，不是装饰噪音。

明确拒绝：玻璃拟态、模糊大阴影、全宽渐变英雄区、纯黑白无彩色、过度衬线杂志风。可爱要克制在工坊尺度里，不要变成豪华店面。
keyCharacteristics: 藏青工坊墨色做文字与描边，糖果粉与薄荷绿做色块，插画用正片叠底贴在纸面上
硬边、实色偏移阴影（无模糊），组件像贴纸
极重无衬线中文标题 + 大写英文标签
双语、像素爱心、微旋转标签是签名细节

rules.name: The Ink-Line Rule
rules.body: 文字与描边只许用 ink / line 这一对工坊青。禁止用纯黑 #000 或中性灰描边。

rules.name: The One Mint Rule
rules.body: 薄荷绿只给主行动按钮。卡片、色带、导航不要再铺一层薄荷。

rules.name: The Bilingual Label Rule
rules.body: 章节 eyebrow 与卡片英文名保持大写英文；情感标题保持中文。不要把 h1/h2 改成英文，也不要把 eyebrow 改成中文句。

rules.name: The Paper Width Rule
rules.body: 内容永远居中收在纸面宽度里，不要做全出血色块英雄（预览顶栏与关于格纸除外）。

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: 阴影必须是 Npx Npx 0 <solid color>。禁止 rgba 模糊投影和大面积 drop-shadow。

rules.name: The Soft-Rect Rule
rules.body: 容器保持带一点点圆的矩形。禁止 999px 胶囊主按钮，禁止完全直角卡片。

dos: Do 用藏青墨色写字、用糖果粉标记喜欢、用薄荷绿做唯一主按钮。
Do 用硬边实色阴影表现贴纸深度，悬停时平移而不是发光。
Do 保持中英分工：中文标题、英文大写标签。
Do 让品牌插画 multiply 贴在腮红纸上，保留像素爱心、✦、↗。
Do 项目卡三色分岗：粉 / 青 / 嫩绿。
donts: Don't 使用模糊卡片阴影、玻璃拟态或全宽渐变英雄。
Don't 把主按钮改成实心藏青或纯白描边胶囊。
Don't 引入第二套展示字体或纯黑/纯灰中性色替换工坊青。
Don't 把三张项目卡刷成同一背景色。
Don't 去掉预览顶栏的「尚未发送」语气，或把演示表单扮成真实下单。
